repo_url.note: Set to the public repository URL at submit time.

commit_sha.shape: full 40-character sha, reachable on a branch of repo_url
commit_sha.note: Set to the full 40-char SHA of the entered commit at submit time.

bundle.shape: one .tar.gz produced by `node cli/makefun.mjs bundle` run from inside the unpacked kit
bundle.note: Produced from the agent sessions that built the entry; not stored in this repo.

transcripts.shape: loose transcript files, alternative to bundle
transcripts.note: Use instead of bundle, not in addition to it.

source.truncation_point: mid-sentence inside the transcripts deliverable description
